001: Can you help me review for tomorrow's exam?
Sure, which part do you find the most difficult?
Especially the verb tenses, I always forget them.
We can do some exercises together, that way you'll practice them.
That would really help me, thanks for taking the time for me.
Don't worry, I'm sure you'll pass it without a problem.
002: I've been studying all afternoon and I can't concentrate anymore.
Rest for a while, your mind needs breaks too.
You're right, but it stresses me out to think I won't get to everything.
If you want, we'll review the most important stuff and then leave it.
That calms me down, better to take it easy.
Of course, a good rest is also part of studying.
003: Do you think the exam will be very hard?
I don't know, but the teacher usually asks about what we saw in class.
Then I should review the notes from the last few weeks.
Yes, and also the exercises we corrected as a group.
I'm going to organize my notes by topic to study better.
Good idea, that way you'll make better use of your time.
004: Have you seen the syllabus the teacher posted?
Yes, I looked at it and there are several points I don't master.
Me neither, especially the technical vocabulary part.
We could make a summary together and share it.
That sounds like a great idea, that way we review faster.
Perfect, let's meet tomorrow morning at the library.
005: I'm really nervous, I don't know if I've studied enough.
Relax, you've been working hard all week.
But I always get really tense when the moment comes.
Take a deep breath and trust what you've learned.
Thanks, I needed to hear that.
Besides, I'm sure you'll do better than you think.
006: Can you lend me your history notes? I lost mine.
Sure, I'll lend them to you no problem, but they're a bit messy.
That's fine, as long as I have the main content.
If you want, I'll tell you which topics are the most important.
That would help me a lot, I don't know where to start.
Well, I'd start with the Industrial Revolution topic.
007: How's your preparation for the literature exam going?
I'm going little by little, but I struggle to memorize the authors.
Same here, there are too many names and dates.
I made some flashcards with the main works, do you want them?
Yes, please, they'd be great for reviewing.
Well, I'll share them with you and we'll study them together.
008: Do you feel like doing a mock exam?
I think it's really useful to see how we manage our time.
We can time ourselves and then grade each other.
Okay, but let's start with the easiest questions.
Sounds good, that way we warm up and then go for the hard ones.
Perfect, that way the real exam won't catch us by surprise.
009: I don't understand this part of the grammar, can you explain it to me?
It's easier than it seems, let me tell you with examples.
Oh, now I see it much more clearly, thanks.
Do you want to do a couple of exercises to practice it?
Yes, better to make sure I understood it well.
Well, let's get to it, you'll see you'll master it in no time.
010: What do you do to stay calm on the day of the exam?
I usually have a good breakfast and arrive with plenty of time to spare.
I think I'll get nervous anyway.
Think that you've already done everything you could to prepare for it.
That's true, in the end all that's left is to give my best.
Exactly, and I'm sure the effort will pay off.
